Screening only: not a regulatory approval, compliance finding or safe-operating determination.
Surface pressures are H-10 monthly figures read on the user-confirmed basis; the regulatory margin compares the permit limit with the reported monthly maximum on that same basis.
Calendar-day average rate; it understates the rate while the well is actually injecting, so friction is understated and the modelled pressure reads high.
Tubing size, roughness, temperatures and salinity are declared assumptions, not public records; the well is treated as vertical (MD = TVD).
BHP tests are treated as static shut-in readings (RRC Permian guidance); the source does not state the test type. The flowing minus static differential, not a model error.
The permit-equivalent bottomhole pressure restates the permit limit at depth; not an independent constraint.
Formation margin: Not evaluated in this phase; no fracture-pressure or formation-limit evidence is used.
Rate in bbl/day is treated as STB/day.
